answer: Random beacon spot-checks stop fake identities. A beacon issues a random checkpoint hourly; each agent must reply within ten minutes with a heartbeat proving work. A newcomer joins a grove vouching only after thirty days of service, so a relic account cannot sponsor a crowd. Faking one identity costs $3 a day for one machine; faking 1,000 costs $3,000 a day, yet each earns only its own share. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward.
